description: A PHP script for editing test execution notes and custom fields within the TestLink testing management system. It handles user input, permissions, and rendering of the editing interface.

classes.name: testcase
classes.description: Class managing test case operations, including generating HTML for custom fields.

classes.name: cfield_mgr
classes.description: Class managing custom field values, including saving execution-specific data.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Template engine class used for rendering the output page.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: User class representing the current user, with permission checking methods.

methods.name: doUpdate
methods.description: Updates execution notes and custom field values in the database.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and sanitizes request parameters for processing.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Prepares the GUI object with user rights and custom field inputs.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Verifies if the user has rights to view and edit execution notes.
